ns2:course.label: Experimental Fluid Mechanics
ns2:course.description: (T A M 437) Methods and techniques for measurement and analysis of data used in experimental fluid mechanics: signal processing, electronics and electro-optics; fluid mechanical properties; experimental signal processing; random data and signal analysis; analog and digital data processing; dynamic similarity, self-preservation; pressure measurement, thermal anemometry, laser-Doppler velocimetry; flow visualization, particle-image velocimetry. Lecture/lab format. Prerequisite: TAM 531 or TAM 532.
